text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
academy...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Perimeter solo training complete. 
Transitioning to stretching.
Uuugh! Hey, get out of the way!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're getting in the way of my night dew 
collecting! Shoo, shoo, go over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then, on another day...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, perfect timing! Dura, let me test 
this on you!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A "Magical Drink" that makes power well up 
inside you! I just made it, and I want to 
have someone drink it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A complete reproduction of an ancient 
recipe... Come! Let the testing begin!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ... ...I refuse to taste-test.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? B-But why!?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Store-bought products have balanced 
nutrition. It makes self-management easier 
and is more efficient.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Grrr~~! What kind of reason is that? 
That's so awful!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! So uptight and serious! Don't come 
crying to me later if you regret it!
choice_data_list: (Ah, maybe they're not on good terms?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is their issue. I had hoped 
they would find a compromise and get along 
peacefully, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah! Are you guys about to grab lunch too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the two of them ended up 
bumping into each other again!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sweep...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, sit here! The seats are all full 
already, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...What? Just so you know, I'm not giving 
up the window seat! I'm testing my solar 
magic here.
choice_data_list:
No... it's just surprising to hear you 
talking so normally.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Did you seriously think we were 
fighting?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The tree-lined street... Ah, that was when 
I was doing voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's dangerous to stop in the middle of a 
busy walkway. Thanks to Sweep pointing it 
out, I realized right away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! That!! Even thinking about it now 
makes me so mad! So—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna make an even more amazing 
drink! One so good that Dura will take one 
look at it and say, 'I simply must drink 
this!'"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aaah! The limited-time giant 
cheese omelet is back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And after I was in the mood for Napolitan 
today, too! Why must you torment me like 
this~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sweep... I was planning on an omelet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So, we can just order both and split them 
in half.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Getting protein from the omelet, and 
recovering from fatigue with the tomatoes 
in the Neapolitan pasta. Efficient."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? Well, that doesn't sound half bad! 
If you insist, I suppose I can accept!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "No matter what."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu♪ I don't dislike that honest 
side of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them chatting in the cafeteria 
looked just like two good friends who hit 
it off...
choice_data_list:
...Are you also interested in the Guts 
Fried Shrimp?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them chatting in the cafeteria 
looked just like two good friends who hit 
it off...
choice_data_list:
...Are you also interested in the Guts 
Fried Shrimp?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: There's no need to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer is a quick decision-maker. That 
should be invaluable for adaptable race 
analysis.
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, you're right! I've got my 
confidence back!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, I get it! Jeez, both of 
you are total race geeks."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...G-Guts Fried Shrimp?! The menu item 
with three giant shrimp on it?!
choice_data_list:
I just really wanted to eat with the two 
of you, too!

I just had to come eat with you two as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Exactly three portions of seafood that 
we were short on. Well then, let's share 
it with Trainer as well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is going to be lively! Omelet, 
Neapolitan pasta, fried shrimp... wait.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want it, it looks like a kid's 
meal~!
